TTCA.dimensions: All dimensions provisional; table V in TN D-7884 is CM THC and is deliberately not used
TTCA.relationship: VerticalShared serves jets X or descent throttle; lateral and axial remain available in both modes
TTCA.mode: neutral selector modeled down/JETS; upward slide selects THROTTLE; travel provisional
TTCA.kinematics: Vertical/lateral arcs and axial slide visual interpretation; internal linkage and cross-axis coupling unresolved
TTCA.throttle: TN D-7884 p10-11 gives 53 degree soft stop plus 10 degrees and center +33; LM10 handbook gives 10-92.5% engine thrust. Different quantities/revisions, not a calibrated mapping.
